mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fgc.commission_transaction ( payment_stage, source_type, source_business_key, source_contract_id, source_sequence, recipient_agent_id, commission_item_id, policy_version_id, settlement_month, due_date, amount, cashflow_type, status, note ) VALUES ( #{paymentStage}, 'GA_MANUAL_PAYMENT', #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{naturalContractId}, #{paymentSequence}, #{agentId}, #{commissionItemId}, #{policyVersionId}, #{settlementMonth}, #{dueDate}, #{amount}, #{cashflowType}, 'DRAFT', #{note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fgc.commission_transaction SET payment_stage = #{paymentStage}, source_contract_id = #{naturalContractId}, source_sequence = #{paymentSequence}, recipient_agent_id = #{agentId}, commission_item_id = #{commissionItemId}, policy_version_id = #{policyVersionId}, settlement_month = #{settlementMonth}, due_date = #{dueDate}, amount = #{amount}, cashflow_type = #{cashflowType}, note = #{note} WHERE commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'DRAFT'

INSERT INTO fgc.transaction_attribution ( commission_transaction_id, attribution_seq, attribution_scope, contract_id, agent_id, attribution_date, attribution_month, attributed_amount, inclusion_status_snapshot, exclusion_type_snapshot, attribution_method, allocation_policy_id, allocation_basis_snapshot, evidence_ref ) VALUES
( #{attribution.paymentId}, #{attribution.attributionSequence}, #{attribution.attributionScope}, #{attribution.contractId}, #{attribution.agentId}, #{attribution.attributionMonth}, #{attribution.attributionMonth}, #{attribution.amount}, #{attribution.inclusionDecisionStatus}, NULLIF(#{attribution.exclusionType}, 'NONE'), #{attribution.attributionMethod}, #{attribution.allocationPolicyId}, CAST(#{attribution.allocationBasisJson} AS jsonb), #{attribution.evidenceRef} )
mapper.select:
SELECT ct.commission_transaction_id AS payment_id, ct.source_business_key, ct.source_sequence AS payment_sequence,
ct.source_contract_id AS contract_id, ct.recipient_agent_id AS agent_id, ci.item_code AS commission_item_code, ci.item_name AS commission_item_name, ct.amount, ct.settlement_month AS attribution_month, ct.due_date AS scheduled_payment_date, ct.payment_stage, ct.status, ct.policy_version_id AS allocation_policy_version, ct.note, ct.created_at, ct.updated_at FROM fgc.commission_transaction ct JOIN fgc.commission_item ci ON ci.commission_item_id = ct.commission_item_id WHERE ct.commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT ta.attribution_seq AS attribution_sequence, ta.contract_id, ta.attributed_amount AS amount, ta.inclusion_status_snapshot AS inclusion_decision_status, COALESCE(ta.exclusion_type_snapshot, 'NONE') AS exclusion_type, ta.allocation_basis_snapshot ->> 'inclusionDecisionReason' AS inclusion_decision_reason, ta.allocation_basis_snapshot ->> 'allocationBasis' AS allocation_basis, ta.evidence_ref, ta.attribution_method FROM fgc.transaction_attribution ta WHERE ta.commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY ta.attribution_seq

SELECT ct.commission_transaction_id AS payment_id, ct.status, ct.amount, ta.attributed_amount,
( SELECT SUM(total_ta.attributed_amount) FROM fgc.transaction_attribution total_ta WHERE total_ta.commission_transaction_id = ct.commission_transaction_id ) AS total_attributed_amount, ta.attribution_month, ta.transaction_attribution_id, ta.contract_id, ct.recipient_agent_id AS agent_id, ct.payment_stage, ct.commission_item_id, ci.item_code, ci.item_name, ct.policy_version_id, ta.inclusion_status_snapshot AS inclusion_decision_status, COALESCE(ta.exclusion_type_snapshot, 'NONE') AS exclusion_type, ta.allocation_basis_snapshot ->> 'inclusionDecisionReason' AS inclusion_decision_reason, ta.allocation_basis_snapshot ->> 'allocationBasis' AS allocation_basis, COALESCE(ta.evidence_ref, ct.evidence_ref) AS evidence_ref, ta.attribution_method FROM fgc.commission_transaction ct JOIN fgc.commission_item ci ON ci.commission_item_id = ct.commission_item_id JOIN fgc.transaction_attribution ta ON ta.commission_transaction_id = ct.commission_transaction_id WHERE ct.commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY ta.attribution_seq FOR UPDATE OF ct

SELECT crs.cap_rule_set_id, cri.cap_rule_item_id, cri.inclusion_status AS rule_inclusion_status, cri.decision_reason, c.monthly_equivalent_first_premium AS base_premium_amount, crs.premium_multiplier, crs.warning_usage_pct, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(other_ta.attributed_amount) FROM fgc.transaction_attribution other_ta JOIN fgc.commission_transaction other_ct ON other_ct.commission_transaction_id = other_ta.commission_transaction_id WHERE other_ta.contract_id = ta.contract_id AND other_ta.inclusion_status_snapshot = 'INCLUDED' AND other_ct.payment_stage = ct.payment_stage AND other_ct.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND other_ct.commission_transaction_id <> ct.commission_transaction_id AND other_ta.attribution_date >= c.contract_date AND other_ta.attribution_date < c.contract_date + INTERVAL '12 months' ), 0) AS existing_included_amount, ( SELECT SUM(compliance_ta.attributed_amount) FROM fgc.transaction_attribution compliance_ta JOIN fgc.commission_transaction compliance_ct ON compliance_ct.commission_transaction_id = compliance_ta.commission_transaction_id WHERE compliance_ta.contract_id = ta.contract_id AND compliance_ta.exclusion_type_snapshot = 'COMPLIANCE_3PCT' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(compliance_ta.evidence_ref), '') IS NOT NULL AND compliance_ct.payment_stage = ct.payment_stage AND ( compliance_ct.status = 'CONFIRMED' OR compliance_ct.commission_transaction_id = ct.commission_transaction_id ) AND compliance_ta.attribution_date >= c.contract_date AND compliance_ta.attribution_date < c.contract_date + INTERVAL '12 months' ) AS compliance_evidence_amount FROM fgc.commission_transaction ct JOIN fgc.transaction_attribution ta ON ta.commission_transaction_id = ct.commission_transaction_id AND ta.transaction_attribution_id = #{transactionAttributionId} JOIN fgc.insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = ta.contract_id JOIN fgc.product_offering po ON po.product_offering_id = c.product_offering_id JOIN fgc.product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id JOIN fgc.cap_rule_set crs ON crs.policy_version_id = ct.policy_version_id AND crs.payment_stage = ct.payment_stage AND c.contract_date >= crs.contract_date_from AND (crs.contract_date_to IS NULL OR c.contract_date <= crs.contract_date_to) AND (crs.insurer_id IS NULL OR crs.insurer_id = c.insurer_id) AND (crs.product_group_code IS NULL OR crs.product_group_code = p.product_group_code) AND (crs.channel_code IS NULL OR crs.channel_code = po.channel_code) JOIN fgc.cap_rule_item cri ON cri.cap_rule_set_id = crs.cap_rule_set_id AND cri.commission_item_id = ct.commission_item_id WHERE ct.commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY (crs.insurer_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, (crs.product_group_code IS NOT NULL) DESC, (crs.channel_code IS NOT NULL) DESC, crs.cap_rule_set_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fgc.cap_check ( contract_id, payment_stage, cap_rule_set_id, refund_rate_table_id, candidate_transaction_id, check_kind, as_of_date, base_premium_amount, refund_12m_amount, compliance_deduction_amount, limit_amount, included_amount, remaining_amount, usage_pct, result_status, calculation_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{paymentStage}, #{capRuleSetId}, #{refundRateTableId}, #{paymentId}, 'PRE_CONFIRM', #{asOfDate}, #{basePremiumAmount}, #{refund12mAmount}, #{complianceDeductionAmount}, #{limitAmount}, #{includedAmount}, #{remainingAmount}, #{usagePct}, #{resultStatus}, CAST(#{calculationSnapshotJson} AS jsonb) )

INSERT INTO fgc.cap_check_detail ( cap_check_id, detail_seq, commission_item_id, item_code, item_name, transaction_attribution_id, classification_snapshot, amount, decision_reason, evidence_ref ) VALUES ( #{capCheckId}, 1, #{commissionItemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{transactionAttributionId}, #{classificationSnapshot}, #{candidateAmount}, #{decisionReason}, #{evidenceRef} )

INSERT INTO fgc.exception_case AS existing ( exception_key, exception_type, severity, status, contract_id, agent_id, policy_version_id, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, title, description ) VALUES ( #{exceptionKey}, #{exceptionType}, #{severity}, 'NEW', #{contractId}, #{agentId}, #{policyVersionId}, 'COMMISSION_TRANSACTION', COALESCE(CAST(#{paymentId} AS varchar), #{sourceEntityId}), #{title}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (exception_key) DO UPDATE SET status = 'NEW', title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE existing.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE fgc.commission_transaction SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE commission_transaction_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
